The repository carries the loadable package, the source of both assemblies, the shipped preset, the JSON schemas under docs/schema/ and this wiki's source under docs/wiki/.

Rimrooms

RimPLC is a separate mod from Rimrooms - Async Industries, the company mod whose automation file the shipped preset's steps are written for. Each is enabled on its own; neither requires the other.

  • Rimrooms wiki: g-fourteen.github.io/Rimrooms-AsyncIndustries
  • The automation file the preset's steps name: Rimrooms -- The interface

Original RimPLC source is MIT licensed; the licence file is at the repository root. RimWorld and its assemblies belong to Ludeon Studios and are not included. The mod preview and the transparent badge are original RimPLC artwork.

RimPLC. A development build; nothing here is a balance, performance or compatibility report.
